headline: Q4 2026 Fiscal Stimulus Seen as a Buffer for Purchasing Power, Not the Main Driver of Growth
summary: Permata Bank Chief Economist Josua Pardede said the fiscal stimulus to be disbursed in Q4 2026 effectively cushions household purchasing power. He does not see it as the main growth driver.
why: Government fiscal stimulus can support consumer spending and growth, and its timing affects economic forecasts for Indonesia.
